notes.title: 1.04 Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you for supporting Toward Dawn. All the feedback has meant the world to me! This patch is focused on adding some extras to the Dragon's Guard cardgame.

[list]
[*] Added new card (Flagbearer) - Buffs ally power. 
[*] Added new card (Jester) - Specialises in swapping the rear/front guard positions.
[*] Added new card (Gwyllgi) - High HP card that deals increased damage the longer it survives.
[*] Added new card (Llamhigyn) - Debuffs enemy power.
[*] Added new card (Twrch Trwyth) - Deals damage back to an enemy when taking damage.
[*] Added new Dragon card (Arianrhod) - Specialises in shields for her team.
[*] Added new Dragon card (Bleiddwn) - Supports Beast cards.
[*] Added new Dragon card (Gwydion) - Specialises in moving opponent cards around.
[*] You can now play the card game in optional locations throughout the story. Each opponent has a unique deck strategy.
[*] Each of these battles (and Bleddyn's battles in ch2/3) will award a card when winning.
[*] Added cards to shop inventories.
[/list]

Diolch
- Devi

notes.title: 1.03 Patch

notes.title: 1.02 Patch
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Toward Dawn! It has been an incredible week, and I am so grateful for everyone taking their time to play the game and share their feedback. My main aim with this game was to explore and share a culture and mythology I love, as well as pay homage to games of my childhood, and seeing the response has been truly lovely.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*][b]Steam Cloud Saving[/b] implementation. You can back up your saves from the following locations:
Windows:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Roaming/Godot/app_userdata/Toward Dawn/
Linux:
~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Toward Dawn/
[*][b]New Game +[/b] After completing the game, there will be a new option in the main menu. You can load a previous save to then start the game again, keeping all your equipment, items and levels.

[*]Fixed a bug where opening the Load Game could potentially not set focus on a button.
[*]You can now scroll through lists by holding input when using a gamepad. (this is actually a problem with Godot Engine, so I have had to implement my own work around. My initial testing seemed fine, but of course a global solution can have unintended consequences)
[*]Fixed dialogue during Liru's sidequest in Ch3 showing the wrong name tag and repeating a dialogue line.
[*]Fixed bug where Idwal's Durge of Storms (Air-Harp skill) would target the party if the Lingering Lightning activated after a counter attack.
[*]Fixed some typos (opening crawl, card game tutorial, unlocalised string in Load Game).
[*]The autosave file now shows "Auto Save" instead of the chapter name watermark (trying to make it clearer what this save file is to people!).
[*]Fixed bug where Idwal's tutorial could popup if you re-enter the Bentref Trail map.
[*]When loading a save, the game will now check and reward any Steam achievements.
[*]Fixed collision for the forest manor outside.
[*]Fixed bug where Bleed Rupture did not remove the bleed stacks afterwards.
[*]Boss enemies will now take reduced damage from poison.
[*]Lingering Lightning no longer triggers other Lingering Lightning.
[/list]

Diolch!
 - Devi

notes.title: Toward Dawn - Demo Update
notes.notes:
With the full release of Toward Dawn tomorrow, the demo has now been updated. This demo contains all the polished content for the main release.

Saves from this demo can be carried forward to the full game.

Thank you for your support for this solo-dev project!
- Devi Serene

Change Log:

[b]Story & Dialogue:[/b]
Added a message notification for when you recieve the Moonblossom Crown after Liru's sidequest in Chapter 3.
Added intro text to the opening of the game. The other chapters all get introductory poems. 
Added hotkey to change dialogue speed / autoplay during dialogue scenes.
Added a new scene for chapter 3, which will optionally take you immediately to the next scene.

[b]Exploration:[/b]
Added achievements
Added new animations for Carys walking and jumping (+veil variants)
Added footstep noises
Added new animation to show the area name in the top left, when entering somewhere new.
Added a Crafting Confirmation modal, you can also choose how many items you want to craft
You can now craft items if one of the ingredients are currently equipped. The new item will replace the equipped item if possible.
Added some alternate dialogue should you gather all the piano key pieces before interacting with the piano in ch3.
Fixed bug that caused the piano puzzle in chapter 3 not to open the bookcase unless you reloaded the map.
Fixed bug in trader UI where items would not properly sort after trading
Fixed bug in trader UI where certain actions could result in no item being focused.
Added new hotkeys for keyboard to enter the Inventory (I), Loadout (L) and AbilityTree (K).
NPCs now have interaction icons
WASD now work in battle and menus
Added input prompts to the party menu tabs

[b]Battle:[/b]
Fixed a bug where the focused ability for Carys' Incantation could not set properly when first opening the menu.
Fixed a bug where Incantation of Regrowth passive would revive all party members on Carys' turn instead of just heal.
Added sound effect for level up.
Updated icons for the enemy intentions. The intentions now show the element or if they are doing a status move.
Fixed a bug where the enemy intention portrait could be misaligned.
Updated the combat UI, showing a unique variant for each character.
Fixed various bugs associated with removal of status effects.
Added options to the Battle screens.
Updated all status effect icons.
Status effect icons are easier to see in battle.
During a unit's turn, they appear in the left hand side "Unit Data" book, allowing easier access to see what their current status effects are.
Updated scroll bar for status effects in the Unit Data book.
If the Unit Data book or Player Portrait has too many status effects to show, it will now gradually scroll across them.
When mouse hovering a status effect, the details will remain in a consistent area.
Fixed a bug where retrying a fight could swap enemy positions.
Retrying a fight will now restore item uses.
Reworked the Battle End UI
Fixed grey background when retrying a fight after a gameover.
Holding select will now speed up the animation for the experience gain.
Updated various spell animations (Arc of Light, Earth Spells, etc).
Fixed bug where an ability could show an incorrect mana cost if disabled via tutorials.
Fixed bug where Carys' status effects could not be hovered with mouse.
You can now mouse over enemies on the right enemy book / turn tracker to highlight them and bring up their details on the left.
The turn tracker portraits now have layering logic - those higher up on the track will have higher priority (appearing on top). Highlighting a unit via targeting or hovering will override that logic and place them on top.
You can now exit the battle end ui by clicking anywhere.
You can now select the Incantations/Empower buttons with the mouse.

[b]Balance:[/b]
Lowered Ceiliog Neidr health and poise
Flux Echo now is random target, but has an upgrade to make it single target.
EarthStrike incantation is now quicker to cast.
Arc Cutter now chains between enemies, the incantation now targets all enemies.
Increased the Health/Poise of enemies in Hard mode.
Carys' Sanctify incantation no longer applies a status effect, instead restoring 50% of the Health damage dealt to herself.
Additional Health/Poise Potency from equipment or passives now only give 50% effect for AOE abilities. (boosting this became way too strong)
Removed Incantation of Dusk as a basic ability - now it is a weapon ability.
Removed Cover ability upgrade tree (Bleddyn still has access to this ability by default).
Added new Base Stats upgrade tree for all characters - Choose between Health/Poise/Potencies/etc to upgrade. This allows you to change how a character plays easier.
Idwal's ability tree unlocks now cost appropriate AP.
Sheltering Veil will now reduce damage taken from a particular element by 80% for one hit.

[b]Other:[/b]
Added a tutorial for the skits. (If you view the first skit before you reach this trigger, the tutorial will not appear)
When using a controller, the mouse cursor will be hidden (if returning to mouse/keyboard, it will show again)
Opening the Steam Overlay will now pause the gameplay / battles / dialogue scenes.
Added support for save transfer from demo to main game (sadly the Next Fest demo version is incompatible)
Added Demo End screen that allows save for transfer, return to menu and quitting.
Added new texture variants for the various abilities in the trees.
Fixed a bug with autosaves that could potentially put you in 0,0 position on load
Added default music and sound effect volume settings - starting at 35% instead of 100%.
Added option to return to the Frontend in the Menu.
Fixed a bug where ability tooltips could remain on the menu.
Fixed a bug in the Incanter's Song minigame causing misses to occur at the opposite end of the tracker.
Audio changes to allow more sound effects to play at the same time, and have the same sound effect to be able to be played multiple times during its playtime.

notes.title: Toward Dawn Demo - Linux Patch
notes.notes:
Shwmae friends! Thank you so much for the lovely feedback on the Next Fest demo, I hope that you are looking forward to the full release!

I am extremely grateful for you support and reviews - this is my first game and it is entirely solo-developed and self funded - and to have people play the game, enjoy the story and embrace the Welsh myths and references has been very humbling. This small update should address some of the more common concerns that were brought up.

[list]
[*] Added a Linux package for the demo. I am unfortunately unable to test this myself, so let me know if it all works correctly! Hopefully it will solve some of the issues that came up before.
[*] Added a new optional scene for Ch2 puzzle that will allow Bleddyn to complete it so the player can continue with the story.
[*] NPCs now have interaction icons.
[*] WASD now work in battle and menus.
[*] Added input prompts to the party menu tabs.
[*] The log puzzles can now be interacted with by mouse click.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Maiden's Hair skit could be seen before returning to home in chapter 2.
[*] The Ability Tree ability buttons now need to be clicked, instead of just moused over (should make it easier to use with mouse).
[*] The party overview UI (shown after standing still for a few seconds) will no longer show during the flashback at chapter 2.
[*] Fixed some off pixels in Carys' animated portraits.
[*] Fixed an off pixel in the frontend startup animation.
[/list]

Diolch! Good luck!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is here, and so is the major demo update. Here is a brief rundown of the updates:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157471/3be31f44a065b360c785d7b82fb686d51c59a41c.gif[/img]
[b]Battle Updates[/b]
Experience a new perspective in battle! Carys and Bleddyn as well as all enemies, backgrounds, and animations have been updated. This was more in line with my original intentions for the game, and I hope that you enjoy the battles more so with how they look and feel!

In addition to looks, some mechanics have also changed.

Carys now has access to Incantations. This allows her to combine two of her spells into a new ability, expanding her versatility greatly. This includes the abilities she can gain via equipment, so experiment to find your favourite combination! 

Bleddyn can consume all of his Mana to Empower his next ability. This increases the damage or effects (such as making it go from single to multi target), and the more mana consumed, the stronger the result.
While the first chapters only feature 2 of the 3 permanent party members, you can still find some guest characters who join for a battle or two!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157471/50aa31d7aa26b00e2959869cb563a7a8986c372f.gif[/img]

All of the UI has been updated. This includes updates to item icons and most ability icons. Hopefully you will agree it is not only a more stylish update but also nicer to use! The game is fully compatible with controllers (my preferred way to play games), or keyboard. I need to add an input prompt, but you can change tabs by using RB/LB or Q/E, so you don't need to use the mouse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157471/58caabf2fbfe0db8a8d9cdea7dc9c6047fc51d72.gif[/img]

Portraits for Carys, Bleddyn and Idwal have all been updated. As have almost all the lines of dialogue from the previous demo - Bleddyn is not quite so Australian anymore (there are still a few 'mates' left in there though)!

I have already received some fantastic feedback from this demo, I'll do my best to add what I can to the full game. Creating Toward Dawn has been a labour of love for the past year and I am grateful to everyone who plays this solo-developed game!

Hwyl fawr! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157471/614e699162650afde3f42b49d9b5ba2429626a8d.gif[/img]
